correctness.rationale: For exactly one eastbound H and one northbound V car, ordered east-then-north updates on m>=2 by n>=2 torus reduce by (a,b)=(xV-xH,yH-yV) to R(1,0)=(1,-1), R(1,1)=(0,1) and otherwise R(a,b)=(a-1,b-1). Free classes labeled a-b mod g=gcd(m,n) and exceptional jumps fully yield: g>=3 at most one block and eventual full period L=lcm(m,n), exactly 2L-1 blocking initial relative positions; g=2 one H and one V block every L+1 complete moves; coprime g=1 one-species blocks with inverse r of m mod n: H only if 2r>n period m(n-r)+1, else V only period mr. Verified full-position closure by displacement multiples and no shorter relative recurrence. Independently physically simulated all 4,125 valid relative placements on 100 grids 2<=m,n<=11, matching periods and block counts; the infinite statement rests on congruence proof.
